name: Flow Boundary
author: Jeremy Longshore
description: Mark when you enter or leave a focus block without sending schedules, projects, or notifications to the cloud. Flow Boundary adds Arrive and Leave actions to the Omarchy bar, keeps its bounded color-coded timeline in Omarchy's local widget settings across shell restarts, with no helper process. Close one task before opening the next, reconstruct where your day changed direction, and build a deliberate transition ritual with no account, cloud sync, calendar access, telemetry, or network requests.

barWidget.description: Persists bounded arrive and leave boundaries in Omarchy's local widget settings with no calendar access.
